# Wardogs: Vehicle Weapon Rates, Seats and Damage Effects

*Generated by [`_tools/vehicle_round39_tables.py`](https://github.com/Kiyogitpy/wardogs-data-docs/blob/main/_tools/vehicle_round39_tables.py) (`--write` refreshes this page and the `assets/data/vehicle-*.json` files). Values are shown as stored in the cooked data unless a cell says otherwise. Reading notes and evidence levels are in the [round 39 evidence](https://github.com/Kiyogitpy/wardogs-data-docs/blob/main/docs/evidence/round39-vehicles-explosives.md).*

## 1. Vehicle weapons: rate and range

Each row is a `WDVehicleWeaponExtensionDataAsset` with the `WDWeaponStatsData` it names. `Rounds/min` marked `*` is the native constructor default of `FWDWeaponStats` (600, offset `+0x138`): the stats asset omits the field. The T-72B3 coaxial PKTM reuses the infantry [`DA_LMG_02_Stats`](https://github.com/Kiyogitpy/wardogs-data-docs/blob/main/data/Wardogs/Plugins/GameFeatures/Weapons/LMG/LMG_02/Content/Data/DA_LMG_02_Stats.json) asset, four vehicles reuse the infantry [`DA_M249_Stats`](https://github.com/Kiyogitpy/wardogs-data-docs/blob/main/data/Wardogs/Plugins/GameFeatures/Weapons/Platforms/WEPN_009/Content/Data/DA_M249_Stats.json), and three share one M2 Browning stats asset. Range is `EffectiveRange` (metres, as the other weapon pages read it).

## 2. Flares and smoke countermeasures

`FWDFlaresSettings` per vehicle. A field the vehicle asset does not set takes the native constructor default (read from `sub_14766AEA0`, RVA `0x766AEA0`): starting flares 0, range 25 to 100, active time 5.0, **cooldown 5.0 s**. No shipped asset sets `FlaresCooldownTime`, so every flare vehicle uses the 5.0 s default.

| Vehicle | Starting flares | Active (s) | Cooldown (s) | Effective range (m) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FWG_01 | 3 | 3.5 | 5 (native default) | 25 to 100 |
| ROT_02 | 2 | 3.5 | 5 (native default) | 5 to 300 |
| ROT_03 | 2 | 3.5 | 5 (native default) | 10 to 300 |
| ROT_04 | 2 | 3.5 | 5 (native default) | 15 to 300 |

Four more vehicle assets carry a smoke countermeasure block (item `Id.Item.VehicleSmoke`, cue `GameplayCue.Vehicle.Countermeasures.Smoke`). The member names are obfuscated in the game files; the byte at `+0x08` sits in the slot where the flare struct keeps its starting amount.

| Gameplay systems asset | Plugin | Byte at +0x08 | Float at +0x0C | Float at +0x10 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SPW | SPW_01 | 255 | 16.0 | 90.0 |
| TNK_03 | TNK_01 | 1 | 16.0 | 90.0 |
| TNK_01_Heavy | TNK_01 | 1 | 16.0 | 90.0 |
| TNK_04 | TNK_04 | 1 | 16.0 | 90.0 |

## 4. Health-trigger effects

Every vehicle `GameplaySystems` asset holds `WDAttributeEffectsTrigger_VehicleHealth` objects: when a health attribute falls below a threshold (percent of that component) its effect objects apply. The export holds 251 thresholds. An effect shown with `{}` serialises no property, so it runs on class defaults that were not read. Cue-only effects are left out.

## 5. Hand repair tools

`HandleApplication` in `B_Action_VehicleRepairTool` sets `RepairAmount` from the item's `ContainerData.UpdateAmount`, passes it to `TryRepairVehicleHealthZone`, and takes the same amount off the item's durability. The `AttributeValue` 5.0 on the same items is not read by that function.

| Item | Health per application | Seconds per application | Health per second | Durability | Time to empty | `AttributeValue` (not read) |
